title: Snatching Your Family Out of Hell
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a remarkable story of household salvation, where a grandmother and grandfather, both in their 70s and 80s, came to know the Lord in a single day. You'll be inspired and motivated to share the gospel with your loved ones, no matter their age or background, and to trust in God's sovereignty in every situation. Join Pastor Chris as he shares the excitement of watching families brought from darkness to light, and discover the joy of being a laborer in God's harvest.
